_comment: The only model weights KiraPick may open (docs/legal/danh-sach-file-ban-tiep-theo.md; per-file basis in docs/legal/phuong-an-3.0.1.md, appendix B). status: verified = may be opened when the file's SHA-256 is one of the pinned ones; pending = basis for the purpose not established yet, never opened; never = never opened, whatever the file. Pinned hashes are the only proof: '<file>.sha256' side files are not trusted. modes: where a verified weight may be used. List content awaits the owner's decision LIST-1; changing a weight's status is a one-line change here. benchmark: whether the weight may be used for internal measurement on the development machine (never shipped, never opened by the app because of this field), decided per weight from its own terms.
